data.narrative:
Eikon Therapeutics is a Series B-stage biotech company with founders including Eric Betzig and Robert Tjian, currently valued at $539M post-money and having raised $1.1B+ cumulatively. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 3 public peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private companies in Biotech & Health, with the most relevant private comps being Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B Series C), Chai Discovery ($3.8B Series C), and New Limit ($3.1B Series C).

Two triangulation methods are applicable here. Stage-progression analysis, applying a typical 1.9x multiplier from Series B to the next financing stage, yields $1.0B. Peer-median benchmarking across the three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies produces $3.8B, with the peer range spanning $3.1B to $10.3B. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (median 9.2x across the sector) cannot be applied due to absence of disclosed revenue for the target.

The two applicable methods triangulate to a valuation range of $870M to $4.4B, with a median of $2.4B. The substantial spread reflects meaningful uncertainty around stage-transition pace and peer selection sensitivity. The current $539M valuation sits at the low end, consistent with early Series B positioning, though the peer-median uplift suggests material upside if Eikon's clinical or commercial trajectory aligns with later-stage biotech peers in the sample.
